record.issue_text: packages/core/EventManager.ts:554 — merge path still uses `booking.references.find(...)` to delete only the first old calendar event while update now fans out over all references, leaving other hosts' stale events behind (P2, conf 50)

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` the update logic was changed to process **all** calendar references (`calendarReference = ...filter(...)` and `for (const reference of calendarReference) { ... updateEvent(...) }`). However, in the merge/cleanup path (`if (newBookingId) { ... }`) it still does `booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"))`, which will delete only the **first** old calendar reference/event. With destination calendars now fanning out to multiple references, this leaves other old calendar events (for other hosts/calendars) undeleted and stale.
